thread:
Maya: pushed a small Figma update — adding a compact runbook card inside alert details + a mini suppression pill variation. https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/runbook-card-mini?node-id=7:45 :eyes:
Alex: looked — love exposing runbook, but worried about vertical height in the details rail.
Sam: can we keep it collapsed by default? most alerts don't have runbooks so default-expansion feels noisy.
Maya: yes, collapsed one-line summary + 'Open runbook' CTA. expand shows editable link + owner + last-run timestamp.
Tess: copy thought — 'Open runbook' -> 'View playbook' matches ops docs better. a11y: collapse toggle needs `aria-expanded` and a visible keyboard focus.
Alex: agreed on aria. also layout debate: details rail vs inline card in the main panel. rail is predictable; inline lets you preview playbook content. tradeoffs?
Sam: perf note — inline expanded cards increase DOM cost on pages with many alerts. rail lets us lazy-load on open.
Maya: my proposal: default to the details rail, but support a lightweight inline "preview" on hover in the alert list using a cached snippet.
Alex: that seems balanced. suppression pill idea: shrink to 'Muted until <time>' + ellipsis hover for full rule. keyboard-wise we should set `aria-label='suppression: muted until <time>'`.
Tess: UX nit — pill contrast is low on dark mode, fails 4.5:1. probably need invert foreground to full white or bump bg.
Sam: also thinking about keyboard affordances — maybe a keyboard toggle to expand suppression preview? not sure if we want a global shortcut.
Alex: another copy tweak: quick action label 'Mute' might confuse users, 'Snooze' is more standard in on-call flows.
Maya: I'll update Figma frames. adding an inline 'Add runbook' editor (link + owner) as a tiny form. example aria: `aria-label='add runbook'`.
Tess: one more integration detail — when channel mapping changes, preview should show final delivery channels (what will actually be notified), not the routing rule text. i.e., show 'Would notify: #alerts, PagerDuty'.
Sam: +1 to showing resolved channels. could also add a 'what-if' toggle to preview alternate routes.
Alex: I'll prototype accessible focus states. quick CSS snippet for the runbook toggle I used elsewhere: ```css
.runbook-toggle:focus{
  outline: 3px solid #ffb400;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
Maya: :thumbsup: thanks — i'll push updated frames tonight and add the playbook wording change. can we do a quick design sync tomorrow 10am to confirm?
Tess: added. @ops-bot can you create the invite + recording?
